---
title: Photo Album
pagetitle: Photo Album
output: html_document
---

Pick a year to see only its photos. Click a photo to see it larger.

```{r album, echo=FALSE, results='asis', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Builds the album from photos.yml (see the comments in that file). New photos come from
# the shared drive with scripts/import_photos.R.
photos <- yaml::read_yaml("photos.yml")$photos
esc <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  gsub('"', "&quot;", x, fixed = TRUE)
}
md <- function(x) gsub("\\*([^*]+)\\*", "<em>\\1</em>", esc(x))  # *mexicana* in italics
plain <- function(x) esc(gsub("*", "", x, fixed = TRUE))
year_of <- vapply(photos, function(p) as.integer(p$year), 0L)
years <- sort(unique(year_of), decreasing = TRUE)
n_photos <- function(n) paste(n, if (n == 1) "photo" else "photos")

cat("```{=html}\n",
    '<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/photo-album.css">\n',
    '<div id="photo-album">\n',
    # Year buttons: plain links to each year's section; photo-album.js turns them into a filter
    '<nav class="pa-years" aria-label="Show the photos of one year">\n',
    sprintf('<a class="pa-year" href="#photo-album" data-year="all">All years <span class="pa-n">%d</span></a>\n',
            length(photos)),
    paste(sprintf('<a class="pa-year" href="#%d" data-year="%d">%d <span class="pa-n">%d</span></a>',
                  years, years, years, vapply(years, function(y) sum(year_of == y), 0L)), collapse = "\n"),
    '\n</nav>\n<p class="pa-status" aria-live="polite"></p>\n', sep = "")
for (y in years) {
  ps <- photos[year_of == y]
  cat(sprintf('<section class="pa-section" id="%d" data-year="%d">\n', y, y),
      sprintf('<h2 class="pa-heading">%d <span class="pa-n">%s</span></h2>\n', y, n_photos(length(ps))),
      '<div class="pa-grid">\n', sep = "")
  for (p in ps) {
    cat(sprintf(paste0('<figure class="pa-item"><a class="pa-open" href="%s">',
                       '<img src="%s" alt="%s" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></a>',
                       '<figcaption>%s</figcaption></figure>\n'),
                esc(p$file), esc(p$thumb), plain(p$caption), md(p$caption)))
  }
  cat("</div>\n</section>\n")
}
cat('</div>\n<script src="assets/photo-album.js"></script>\n', "```\n", sep = "")
```
